thread.text:
With @Google:

Google is turning AI Mode into a travel booking layer.

Flight price tracking, points/miles rates, and hotel checkout now live inside one conversation.
thread.alt_text: Overview card showing Google AI Mode travel features: flight price tracking, points/miles rates, and hotel booking in one conversation.

thread.text:
The integration is genuinely useful for simple trips.

You can set price alerts without leaving the chat, see points costs for Alaska, American, Hilton, and others, and book via Google Pay.

But the ranking logic is invisible.
thread.alt_text: Screenshot of Google AI Mode showing a hotel list with booking options and partner logos.

thread.text:
This is a classic search-to-transaction experiment.

Google reduces task switching, but commercial opacity could push users back to Kayak or direct airline sites for final decisions.

Would you book a hotel inside AI Mode without seeing why it's ranked first?

xiaohongshu.title: Google把旅行预订塞进AI Mode
xiaohongshu.body:
最近 Google 在 Search 的 AI Mode 里加入了航班价格追踪、积分兑换查询和酒店预订。我试了一下，确实方便：不用在 Google Flights、航空公司和酒店官网之间来回跳，一个对话就能搞定。

但用着用着，我发现一个关键问题：推荐排序不透明。比如搜酒店，AI Mode 会列出合作方，但我不知道排在前面的酒店是因为价格最优、评分最高，还是因为它是合作方。如果我不能验证排序依据，我可能会回到 Kayak 或直接去航空公司官网做最终决定。

积分兑换功能初始合作伙伴有限，酒店预订也仅在美国英语环境推出。对话式界面适合简单行程，复杂多城市行程还是得靠传统工具。

AI Mode 的旅行功能更像一个试点，解决了简单场景的效率问题，但商业信任还没建立。Google 需要在产品里明确标注商业关系，提供可验证的排序依据。

你会因为方便而在 AI Mode 里直接预订酒店，还是坚持去比价网站确认后再下单？
